svg.title: Sample Agent · investment-assistant · Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
svg.text: Sample Agent · investment-assistant · Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
a reference agent on its own runtime and IAM role; every external quote goes through one gateway whose Cedar policies name that role · two tools, two shapes
AWS Cloud · one Region · platform account

1 portal/API -> 2 backend routes the clone to the sample runtime -> 3 SigV4 to the sample-tools gateway -> 4 policy engine permits (role, tool, symbol) -> 5 Lambda target, keyless upstream -> 6 OpenAPI target, key injected from AgentCore Identity
